messages:
Maya (Design): quick check — pushing a small iteration to the Alerting > Thresholds drawer. Main goals: make the preview linear (single column list) and reduce noisy toasts when toggling suppressions. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/s/abc123 Sam - Eng: saw it, nice. quick flag: keyboard tab order currently lands on the channel picker after the preview button. I think Preview should be in the main tab flow before channel controls. Olivia - PM: agreed. Also re: copy on the suppression toggle — 'Snooze for 1h' feels too transactional. Maybe 'Suppress notifications for 1 hour' — clearer for customers. Ravi - Eng-ML: accessibility note — when preview updates, we need an aria-live region so screen readers announce the change rather than relying on the toast. Toasts vanish for non-visual users. Alex - Accessibility: +1 to aria-live. Also contrast on the 'Preview' badge is 3.9:1 with bg; needs to hit 4.5:1. Small tweak but important for AA. Sam - Eng: on noisy toasts — current implementation fires a toast every time a suppression row changes. Proposed: coalesce events into a single toast or only show toasts for errors. Happy to pair with Maya to update UX. Maya (Design): thanks — action items: 1) move Preview earlier in tab order, 2) switch suppression copy to 'Suppress notifications for X', 3) add aria-live region for preview updates, 4) bump preview badge contrast. I'll push updated figma and call a 20m sync. Who's free at 10:30? Olivia - PM: I can. Also one more UX ask: preview ordering should reflect notification priority (pager > email > slack). If user reorders channels, preview should follow that order. Sam - Eng: implemented channel-order mapping in backend already but not wired to preview UI. I can hook it up after the design update. Ravi - Eng-ML: example aria snippet I used elsewhere: ```
Preview updated: 2 channels will be notified
``` Will drop it in the PR. Alex - Accessibility: also ensure the suppression switch has an accessible name like 'Suppress notifications for ' and the duration slider announces values. Maya (Design): perfect. I'll update the figma frames and post a new link. Thanks everyone :heart: deploy-bot: new figma link posted: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/alerting-thresholds
